blocks.x: Automotive and discrete plants chase three numbers, OEE, escapes and launch time. Sensor fabric, vision inspection and scheduling intelligence move all three simultaneously, while IATF traceability and IT/OT security raise the baseline every program must respect. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in line changeover sequencing, vision inspection, predictive maintenance, with iatf traceability close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
The recurring pressure points, Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing edition:

items: Legacy lines uninstrumented; OEE components and energy per unit are estimates.
Defect detection by eyes/sampling; escapes reach customers and recalls cost millions.
Body-shop and assembly sequencing by spreadsheet; changeover minutes bleed OEE.
IATF lot traceability assembled from documents; recall scoping takes days.
OT/IT convergence without segmentation; ransomware stops lines.
Job-shop complexity exceeds solver ceilings; better sequences exist but can't be found in time.
